integrity: Complete proof, explicit domain, independently replayable finite exact checker, finite computations not asserted as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Rational action of the canonical dihedral group on Ind(GP(n,2)) for n divisible by five only. Uses Kim 2026 nonequivariant homotopy theorem; does not determine integral homology lattices, geometric fixed loci, quotient torsion or exceptional full automorphism actions. Previously known small cases do not establish novelty of the uniform family; residual unindexed priority risk. Independent validation not performed.
title: The signed five-point dihedral character of generalized Petersen independence complexes
